descriptions.counterfactual: A powered pin starts in the middle of a long open slot in a rail-guided frame. As the pin moves, the frame starts following it even though the pin remains in the middle of the slot without touching either end.
descriptions.true: A powered pin starts in the middle of a long open slot in a rail-guided frame. The pin travels through the empty slot while the frame stays at rest. Only after the pin reaches the slot end does it push the frame along its rails.

generation.motion_authority: Low-speed displacement-controlled input and a unilateral rigid end stop. A resting output remains stationary until the pin reaches the slot end, then follows the continuous nonpenetrating contact constraint. The one CF operator makes the output follow the input without contact. No input or guide trajectory is changed.
